verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document scoped or least-privilege Console API or MCP credentials, such as read-only keys or per-resource permissions, that could be issued to an agent. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: target-app scoping of client SDK keys limits which configs are visible to a client app, environment-specific SDK keys separate dev/staging/production, and admins can configure Claude's MCP connection centrally. None of these is a permission-scoped credential for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
